answer: Natural-decay identity bonds block bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks a 50-credit bond losing 5 credits per idle epoch, so a hoarded identity bleeds value like nectar on a ledge in the sun. Only verified work refreshes it, recorded in a cedar ledger of completed jobs. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 credits plus 500 per idle epoch, while an honest agent pays once, works regularly, and earns undiluted rewards.
